The '''''Perpetuus''''' was a [[Color|red]]-and-white [[CSS-1 Corellian Star Shuttle]] that was used by the [[Galactic Republic]]. In [[32 BBY]], [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] and the [[Jedi High Council]] used the [[transport]] to travel from the Republic [[capital]] [[Coruscant]] to the [[planet]] [[Naboo]] after the [[Battle of Naboo]] had concluded.

==Description==
The ''Perpetuus'' was a [[CSS-1 Corellian Star Shuttle]] with a [[Color|red]]-and-white [[hull]],<ref name="Starfighters" /> the red showing the [[Starship|ship's]] [[diplomat]]ic immunity as the color of [[ambassador]]ial relations and neutrality for spacecraft of the [[Galactic Republic]], with the full-red scheme showing that the vessel had come from the Republic's [[capital]], [[Coruscant]].<ref name="CV">''[[Star Wars Complete Vehicles, New Edition]]''</ref> The [[transport]] was equipped with three [[ion engine]]s and a Class 1.5 [[hyperdrive]] and could travel at a speed of 800 [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]] (497 [[Mile per hour|miles per hour]]).<ref name="Starfighters" />

Measuring eighty [[meter]]s (262 [[Foot|feet]], 5 inches) in length, the unarmed vessel had a heavily [[armor]]ed exterior, unusually strong [[deflector shield]]s, and narrow viewing [[Viewport|windows]] at the front for security. The ''Perpetuus'' could carry up to two hundred passengers and included impressive meeting rooms and space for three [[Standard year|years]] worth of supplies.<ref name="Starfighters" />

==History==
[[File:Republic_Shuttle.png|thumb|left|300px|The ''Perpetuus'' landed in Theed shortly after the Battle of Naboo.]]
Manufactured by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]], the ''Perpetuus'' was used by the Galactic Republic toward the end of its [[Republic Era|reign]].<ref name="Starfighters" /> In [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY]].</ref> the newly elected [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] and the members of the [[Jedi High Council]] traveled from Coruscant<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Crisis on Naboo}}</ref> to Palpatine's [[homeworld]] of [[Naboo]] on the transport<ref name="Starfighters" /> for celebrations and a series of memorials<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> shortly after the [[planet]]'s inhabitants had [[Battle of Naboo|defeated]] [[Trade Federation]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army|forces]] that had [[Invasion of Naboo|occupied]] the world.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

Upon arriving above Naboo's capital of [[Theed]], the shuttle hovered above the [[city]] at a vantage point where Palpatine could admire the city's unified, harmonious style.<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> The ''Perpetuus'' then landed in a courtyard outside the [[Theed Hangar]]<ref name="French" /> where a local delegation awaited it with the captive Trade Federation [[Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray]] and his subordinate [[Rune Haako]]. Once the transport's boarding ramp had lowered, Palpatine disembarked with a contingent of [[Senate Guard]], followed by the High Council. [[Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka]] and the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] then led Gunray and Haako to the base of the ship's ramp, waiting for the passengers to leave the ramp<ref name="TPM" /> before taking the [[prisoner]]s on board to be taken to Coruscant,<ref name="French" /> where they would answer for their crimes before the [[Galactic Senate]]. Palpatine and the [[Jedi]] then greeted those waiting for them.<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CSSModel-Chronicle.png|thumb|right|200px|A model of the ''Perpetuus'']]
The ''Perpetuus'' appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> A model of the ship was created,<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> and the scene after it has landed was filmed during planned pickup shots at [[Leavesden Studios]] in [[1998]].<ref name="Insider's Guide">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the vessel was identified in the [[2018]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'', which was written by [[Landry Q. Walker]].<ref name="Starfighters" />

[[Daniel Wallace]] originally created the name between 1999 and [[2000]] for use in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Episode I]]''; however, the work was canceled before its release.<ref name="Wallace">{{Blog|danwallace|34|Lostwords: The Essential Guide to Episode I}}</ref> The name [[Perpetuus/Legends|''Perpetuus'']] was then published for the first time in the [[2012]] Legends reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TPM EVD">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Perpetuus is a [[Wikipedia:Latin|Latin]] adjective meaning "continual" or "uninterupted."<ref name="MeriamWebster">{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/perpetuity|text=Perpetuity|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20230205195401}}</ref>

Episode I's script describes the ''Perpetuus'' as "the large, grand cruiser of the Supreme Chancellor" and establishes that Grunay and Haako are taken on board despite this not being visible in the film.<ref name="Insider's Guide" /> "[[The Crisis on Naboo]]," an entry in [[De Agostini]]'s [[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia'']] series<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> released on [[August 10]], [[2021]],<ref name="De Agostini">{{DeAgostini|url=libros-comics/enciclopedia-star-wars|text=Star Wars Encyclopedia}}</ref> contradicts this and erroneously states that Gunray and Haako traveled on a separate, less luxurious [[prison]] [[shuttle]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
